svg.title: What I do: AI agents, automation, web apps, e-commerce, real-world systems, teaching.

g.text: Agents with real write access to live systems,
each behind a validator and a human approval.
sync and alerts. Mostly self-hosted n8n.
Full products end to end: interface, database,
auth, deploy, and the monitoring afterwards.
Storefronts, sync plugins and ops tooling
for stores that ship every day.
Scanners, cameras and label printers wired
into software that people run by hand.
Author and instructor of a 13-module course
